newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP sees A$75 mln book gain on sale.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP sees A$75 mln book gain on sale.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP) said on Thursday it would recognise a book gain on the sale of its 616 million shares in Fosters Brewing Group Ltd of about A$75 million.
BHP said it would apply the proceeds from the sale for the repayment of debt.
BHP announced earlier it had sold 86 percent, or 616 million shares, of its holding in Foster's to a major international investment bank and an Australian stockbroker.
The 31.4 percent of Foster's issued capital was expected to be placed immediately in Australian and international markets at A$2.49 a share, it said.
BHP said its remaining 100 million shares in Foster's would be offered to its shareholders after October 5, 1997.
As part of the deal, Foster's has agreed to buy back 254.45 million of its shares from Japan's Asahi Breweries Ltd.
BHP managing director John Prescott said in a statement the agreement would allow BHP and Foster's to maximise value for shareholders.

BHP had been able to realise the value created in Foster's over recent years, while the shareholder offer would allow BHP shareholders who believed they could benefit from a continued holding in Foster's to do so, he said.
